def YearUniversityAdmission(n, array):
    total = sum(array[:n])
    return total // n

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    
    years = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    
    print(YearUniversityAdmission(n, years))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
